levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A before photo shows the problem, the location is specific enough to walk to, the answer says what goes wrong and who it affects, and the fix names what will be made.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of the four is vague or missing: a general location, a problem without who it affects, or a fix that does not say what will be made.

levels.label: Developing
levels.short: Two or more vague or missing
levels.descriptor: Two or more of the four are vague or missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Not submitted, or not a real attempt: a placeholder, an off-topic answer or an unrelated photo.

criterion: Part 1: The problem and your fix: The problem and fix are clearly defined

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Design A and Design B build the same fix two different ways: a different mechanism, layout, parts or way of holding.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Two designs that differ in a real way but share most of their parts.

levels.label: Developing
levels.short: Same design twice, or only one
levels.descriptor: Only one design, or the second is the first at a different size.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No sketches, or not a real attempt.

criterion: Part 1: Two designs: Two genuinely different designs for the fix

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Both sketches show both major components with every dimension needed to make them, the material, and the critical interface circled.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Nearly complete: one or two dimensions, a material, or the interface mark is missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Several dimensions are missing, so a part could not be made without guessing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Sketches have no usable dimensions, or are not attached.

criterion: Part 1: Two designs: Sketches could be built from

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Picks A or B, states it in one line, and gives a reason tied to machine time, available stock, safety, or how the fix gets used.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Picks one, but the one-line solution is missing or the reason could apply to any project.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No choice made, or no reason given.

criterion: Part 1: Two designs: Choice is explained

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every part is listed with role, material and stock size, and machine; two major parts; one major part machined with two or more machined features; machined parts have a backup machine.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One part, stock size, machine or backup is missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.short: Several gaps or a rule broken
levels.descriptor: Two or more gaps, or a project rule is broken, such as no machined major part or a printed major part.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No parts list, or not a real attempt.

criterion: Part 1: Stock, parts and hardware: Parts list is complete and follows the rules

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Stock for both major parts is pulled and labeled, shown in photos, and every fastener is listed and found in the IDEA bins, or no fasteners are needed.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of these is not done yet: a label, a photo, or a fastener not checked in the bins.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more of those are not done.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No stock photo and no hardware list, or not a real attempt.

criterion: Part 1: Stock, parts and hardware: Stock and hardware are ready

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Both major components are modeled and match the chosen design, with any changes from the sketch explained.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both are modeled, and one is missing a feature or a change is not explained.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one major component is modeled.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No CAD, or not a real attempt.

criterion: Part 2: CAD: Both parts are modeled

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The two parts are assembled and the screenshot makes the critical interface easy to see.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The parts are assembled but the interface is hidden or too small to see.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The parts are only shown separately.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No assembly screenshot.

criterion: Part 2: CAD: The assembly shows the interface

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Each drawing carries every dimension needed to make its part, with none repeated inside the same drawing. A mating size may appear on both drawings.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One problem: one dimension missing, or one repeated inside a drawing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more problems (missing or repeated dimensions, in any mix), or one drawing is missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No drawings, or not a real attempt.

criterion: Part 2: Drawings: Parts can be made from the drawings

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every dimension that sets the critical dimension carries its own tolerance, on the drawing of the part where that feature is made. A general tolerance in the title block does not count.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Some of those dimensions carry a tolerance, but not all.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No tolerance on the critical dimension.

criterion: Part 2: Drawings: The critical dimension carries a tolerance

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every feature shows in a view, and both title blocks carry material, name and part name.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A feature is hidden in every view, or title block fields are missing, but the drawings are still readable.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Views or title blocks are missing throughout.

criterion: Part 2: Drawings: Views and title block

levels.label: Complete
levels.short: Every step with tool, time, check
levels.descriptor: Every step to make the machined part is listed in an order that would work, each with machine, tool and holding, minutes, and a measurement check, plus a toolpath or setup sheet.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One step is missing its tool, time or check, one step is out of order, or the toolpath or setup sheet is missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more steps are incomplete, or the order would not work.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No process plan, or not a real attempt.

criterion: Part 2: Process plan: Steps are complete and in a workable order

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Says what they will do when their machine is taken, and names a step that could move to the backup machine.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Gives one of those two.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Answer is too general to act on.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Not answered.

criterion: Part 2: Process plan: Plan for a busy machine

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names the critical dimension, gives its designed value and tolerance and a predicted actual value in inches, says how it will be measured, makes the first-try call, and shows it on the drawing.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of those is missing or unclear.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more are missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No prediction.

criterion: Part 2: Lock your prediction: Prediction is stated in numbers

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names the machine, feature or step expected to push the critical dimension off, and which way: bigger or smaller.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names a machine, feature or step, but not which way.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A reason that could apply to any part (human error, being careful), a direction with no cause, or a reason that does not match this part.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No reason given, or not a real attempt.

criterion: Part 2: Lock your prediction: The reason is specific
